description:
Ghaith Ãrnason is built compact and efficient, dark-skinned with close-cropped hair she dyes a deep arterial red â€” not geneware, just dye, because she likes having a choice about it. She has bioluminescent capillary lines mapped faintly across both forearms, a cosmetic mod she got at nineteen that she now finds embarrassing but can't afford to remove, which she will tell you about if you ask and sometimes if you don't. Her surgical augments are serious: stabilizer rigs in both hands, haptic-magnification implants behind her eyes, a subdermal sterile field generator she refers to as 'the bubble.'

She was two years into a Helix Biosystems surgical residency when she was caught diverting a cadaver organ to a patient who couldn't pay the licensing fees. She does not think she did anything wrong. She thinks Helix Biosystems is wrong, the organ licensing system is wrong, and the entire apparatus that let that patient die six weeks after her termination is wrong. She has constructed an entire ethical framework around her current work â€” she harvests from the willing (paid donors, usually desperate Tier 1s), she maintains sterile conditions that would shame most licensed clinics, and she charges sliding scale. She genuinely saves lives. She also genuinely sells kidneys to Axiom black-market med-brokers for Î¦4,000 a unit. Both things are true.

Losing surgical precision â€” her hands failing her

To be seen as a healer, not a criminal

psychology.secret: One of her regular donors â€” a young man named Oskar who has sold her two non-essential organs â€” is showing signs of a systemic rejection cascade she recognizes from her residency training. She knows he's dying. She has not told him because he's scheduled for a third procedure next week and she needs the inventory. She lies awake about this.

physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, precise fade on the sides, slightly longer on top â€” maintained with surgical attention to detail

Even tone characteristic of someone spending most daylight hours underground.
physical_description.complexion: Methodical grooming, hands kept obsessively clean despite the work. Fine-lined face suggesting chronic low-grade stress. Strong cheekbones and defined jawline characteristic of Middle Eastern and South Asian heritage, with the subtle softening from Northern European admixture. Lips often chapped from breathing recirculated air in her cold-storage clinic. No cosmetic work beyond the regrettable neon tracery.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent capillary tracery in faint neon-blue lines mapping across both forearms in vascular-system patterns, brightest at the wrists; a nineteen-year-old decision she now describes with embarrassment and defensive precision

physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent forearm tracery (always visible). Stabilizer rigs in both hands visible as subtle metallic articulation at knuckles and wrist joints when hands are in motion or light catches them. Eyes show faint silver scarring at inner canthi. The subdermal sterile-field generator and haptic-magnification implants are invisible unless she's actively using them â€” then her eye-focus becomes unnaturally precise and her hands move with mechanical accuracy.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled. Hands move with surgical precision even when casual; she's learned not to make sudden gestures in clinical spaces. Stands with weight balanced forward slightly, ready to move. Rarely touches her own face. When focused on work, enters a state of almost meditative concentration â€” everything extraneous falls away.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian. Loose dark scrubs or surgical-grade clothing in charcoal or black, often with visible staining from work that she doesn't fully clean out because she'll just get more on them. Reinforced cargo pants with deep pockets for tools and supplies. A weathered synth-leather jacket (high-quality, probably five years old, maintained obsessively) for moving through Shallowgrave proper. No jewelry â€” too much contamination risk. Wears disposable nitrile gloves constantly, carries multiple pairs in jacket pockets.
